parse.title: Items
parse.wikitext:
== Witch ==
The Witch Shop stocks 3 items:
* '''Broom''' — 15,000 cash. Faster travel for chasing or escaping; low durability, so don't spam it.
* '''Candle''' — required to cast witch spells (5 needed); the shop lists a max of 5.
* '''WitchBag''' — acts like an item saver: if you leave a server, all the items you collected stay with you.


== Hunter Shop ==
The Hunter Shop stocks 6 items:
* '''Gartic Potion''' — HUMANS ONLY
* '''Night Vision''' — $450
* '''Cross''' — HUMANS ONLY; a human-only weapon from the Hunter's Shop. Holding it near a Vampire repels them and knocks them backward; if the Vampire keeps approaching, it sets them on fire, and the longer the Vampire persists, the more fire damage they take, potentially killing them. It has limited durability, so it can't be used forever. To bless it, you must be a Human at Level 200+ and take it to the church.
* '''Training Dummy''' — HUMANS ONLY
* '''Werewolf Ring''' — WEREWOLVES ONLY, $400000, permanent, full wolf mode (see [[Werewolf]])
* '''Wolfsbane Potion''' — HUMANS ONLY; use it to become immune to werewolf infection for 20 minutes. It can be dropped, and another dose cannot be consumed while the protection is active.

* '''XP Booster''' — $100000
* '''Dish''' — $450

== Weapons Shop ==
